title: Scripted SMP Config
description: A Config System for Scripted Minecraft SMPs
body:
Minecraft Scripted Config.


The plugin is for your next Minecraft Scripted SMP project. 

You can change your language between German and English in the config. 

With /session lock a scene is activated where people cannot join while it is activated. 

With /session unlock the locked scene is unlocked. 

/session whitelist
add/remove removed or add the player from the whitelist 

With /mute you can mute players 

/unmute Allows you to unmute players

/ban A custom ban message comes where you will be banned for 3 days.

/unban To be unbanned.

Further information

If you die, the player will be banned for 30 minutes 

The plugin is available in complete 1.21

If you have any questions about the plugin, please report it in my Discord!
